svg.title: Refutation / תיובתא
svg.desc: A decisive challenge breaks the statement block inside a distinctive red hexagonal outline. The user explicitly requested this six-sided stop-sign-like carrier to distinguish Refutation from the triangle series. The intact arrow and two jagged, separated pieces retain their previous geometry, enlarged and centered in the new frame. Unlike Objection, the claim does not remain standing intact. Unlike Apparent Contradiction, the drawing shows defeat rather than two unresolved opposing statements. This is a visual exception to family inheritance; Ramchal still lists Refutation as a Difficulty subtype on Hebrew p179. The distinguishing meaning uses standard Talmudic sources at the user's explicit request. A contradictory authoritative source can defeat a claim without an internal contradiction in the claim's own reasoning. The icon does not assert that every occurrence determines the final halachic ruling.
